title: Art. 44 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter V - Carriage by Air Performed by a Person other than the Contracting Carrier, Article 44 — Aggregation of Damages
theme: Carriage by Air Performed by a Person other than the Contracting Carrier
content: In relation to the carriage performed by the actual carrier, the aggregate of the amounts recoverable from that carrier and the contracting carrier, and from their servants and agents acting within the scope of their employment, shall not exceed the highest amount which could be awarded against either the contracting carrier or the actual carrier under this Convention, but none of the persons mentioned shall be liable for a sum in excess of the limit applicable to that person.
